currentRecommendation.action: Open the selected review handoff, watch/listen to the current segment, and record draft notes before touching the official ledger.
currentRecommendation.why: The official ledger is still pending and the durable draft review packet is incomplete.

editingPassSteps.label: Watch the selected segment in Program Output.
editingPassSteps.plainEnglish: Treat this like an edit review. Does the episode feel watchable, coherent, and not weirdly paced?

editingPassSteps.label: Check the 9:16 cut for face placement and caption safety.
editingPassSteps.plainEnglish: If the crop puts words or faces in awkward places, leave a note instead of fighting the ledger.

editingPassSteps.label: Listen for comfort, clipping, obvious level problems, or distracting noise.
editingPassSteps.plainEnglish: Audio can pass even if it is imperfect; the question is whether a real viewer/listener will bounce.

editingPassSteps.label: Drop notes where the tool slows you down.
editingPassSteps.plainEnglish: Quipsly is learning the workflow too. If the editor makes review harder, that is a product bug.

editingPassSteps.label: End with one outcome: looks good, needs edit, or blocked.
editingPassSteps.plainEnglish: The system will translate that into official review state later. The human job is judgment.

makoEditorOutcome.recommendation: Do an editor pass first. Watch, listen, crop-check, then leave a plain-English outcome note.

northStar: Mako edits. Quipsly remembers. Codex learns. Tower proves.
reviewerPromise: You are not being asked to operate a review bureaucracy. Watch the work, adjust or note what feels wrong, and let Quipsly keep the receipts underneath.

safeCommands.addAudioNeedsEdit: script/agentctl.sh episode1-mako-review-note needs-edit audio 01:02:30 "Audio comfort note."
safeCommands.addBlocked: script/agentctl.sh episode1-mako-review-note blocked media segment-005 "Blocked because..."
safeCommands.addLooksGood: script/agentctl.sh episode1-mako-review-note looks-good overall segment-005 "Looks good from editor review."
safeCommands.addQuickNote: script/agentctl.sh episode1-mako-review-note note tool general "What I noticed while editing/reviewing."

suggestedOutcomes.label: Looks good
suggestedOutcomes.meaning: The segment feels publishable from this pass.

suggestedOutcomes.label: Needs edit
suggestedOutcomes.meaning: The content is usable but needs cut, crop, audio, caption, or pacing changes.

suggestedOutcomes.label: Blocked
suggestedOutcomes.meaning: Something prevents fair review, such as missing media, wrong export, broken audio, or unusable playback.

truth: This is an editor-facing review brief. It does not mutate the official review ledger, approve artifacts, publish, schedule, upload, or capture receipts.
underlyingReviewPrompts: Watch every selected video review clip and listen to the selected audio review clip.
Use the per-row draft-response commands to record what was actually reviewed.
Answer the human review questions in the durable draft response ledger.
If there is a problem, copy an issue command instead of marking reviewed.
Only after real review and durable notes should the official review ledger command be considered.
